name: merkle-tree-zkp
description: 머클트리 증명 ZKP 회로 - 새로운 도전!

scripts.step2-2: snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot12_0000.ptau pot12_0001.ptau --name="First contribution" -v -e="random text"
scripts.step2-3: snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot12_0001.ptau pot12_final.ptau -v
scripts.step3-2: snarkjs zkey contribute merkle_proof_0000.zkey merkle_proof_0001.zkey --name="1st Contributor Name" -v -e="Another random entropy"
scripts.step3-3: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey merkle_proof_0001.zkey verification_key.json
scripts.step4-1-valid: snarkjs groth16 fullprove input_valid.json 04_merkle_proof_js/04_merkle_proof.wasm merkle_proof_0001.zkey proof_valid.json public_valid.json
scripts.step4-1-invalid: snarkjs groth16 fullprove input_invalid.json 04_merkle_proof_js/04_merkle_proof.wasm merkle_proof_0001.zkey proof_invalid.json public_invalid.json
scripts.step4-2-valid: snarkjs groth16 verify verification_key.json public_valid.json proof_valid.json
scripts.step4-2-invalid: snarkjs groth16 verify verification_key.json public_invalid.json proof_invalid.json
scripts.step5: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier merkle_proof_0001.zkey verifier.sol
scripts.all: npm run step1 && npm run step2-1 && npm run step2-2 && npm run step2-3 && npm run step3-1 && npm run step3-2 && npm run step3-3
scripts.test-valid: npm run step4-1-valid && npm run step4-2-valid
scripts.test-invalid: npm run step4-1-invalid && npm run step4-2-invalid
scripts.test-all: npm run test-valid && npm run test-invalid
scripts.clean: rm -f *.ptau *.zkey *.r1cs *.sym verification_key.json verifier.sol proof_*.json public_*.json && rm -rf 04_merkle_proof_js/
